name: Container Image Artifact Download
description: Downloads container image artifact uploaded by container-image-artifact-upload action.

container_engine.description: Container engine to leverage for packaging an image

workflow.description: Name of the workflow to download image from.

token.description: Github token with read permission to artifacts in given repo.

download_tmp_dir.description: Temporary directory to download assets (default to OS temp dir).

workflow_event.description: Name of event that triggered the workflow run.

workflow_run_id.description: Exact run id for the workflow.
